headline: Turkish company to manage "Oltin bel" tourist complex in Kumushkon (+photo)
summary: Uzbekistan's president visited the Oltin bel tourism complex in Kumushkon, which includes four five-storey hotels and 51 houses. Turkey's Elite World, with 46 years of experience, will manage the hotels.
why: Elite World is a Turkish hotel management company, and tourism investment in Central Asia is a growing segment for regional hospitality operators.
original_headline: Kumushkondagi “Oltin bel” sayyohlik majmuasini Turkiya kompaniyasi boshqaradi (+foto)
